{{Quote|Sir, a mine in sector 9G was just detonated.|The droid speaking with Osi Sobeck|<ref name="The Citadel">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''OOM security battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] at the time of the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

==Biography==
During the imprisonment of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] by the Separatists in the Citadel prison on Lola Sayu, this [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|Security droid]] along with many others were under command of prison warden [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] in the Citadel's [[Citadel Command/Legends|command room]] and controlled the Citadel's [[Electro-mine/Legends|Electro-mine]] sensors.

===Battle of Lola Sayu===
When the elite team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived on the planet in an attempt to free the captive Even Piell, one of the [[Charger/Legends|clone troopers]] accidentally hit an electro-mine while free climbing the Citadel's walls. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] proceeded to warn Osi Sobeck of this incident and he ordered that the whole Citadel be placed under alert.

==Behind the scenes==
This OOM security battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
